text: Being a creature feels quicker. It now moves the moment you push the stick, steps sideways when you push sideways, and runs when you push the stick all the way. Birds bank with the stick and climb or dive where you look, and fish do the same in the water. A spell reaches further the stronger it is, up to a village across a valley. Hold Cast, or hold a finger still on the island, to show the ring and drag it into place, then lift to cast. Lift over Cancel to keep the spell. Far land fades into mist, so the view runs smoother on a phone.
